# Spoken Miles: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-28 · code f202f280cac2 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** 45-minute hands-free audio lessons for the car: hear English, say it in Spanish, French or Italian. Lifetime access, works offline. Lesson 1 free.
**Live:** https://spokenmiles.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/sayback · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/sayback/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py sayback` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- Player features (2026-11-20): trip length, thinking time, link refresh and the ring all live in `theme/assets/sb-player.js`
  (engine) + `client_code/Pages/Lesson` (prefs `sb.trip`/`sb.think`, position mirror `sb.pos.<course>.<code>`, `_unsent`).
  Thinking cues = `server_code/cues_data.py` from `tools/make_catalog.py --cues-only`.
- Weekly goal + rest-day streak: `Listening.stats/streak_of/goal_of/set_goal`, table `listener_prefs` (read in try/except),
  ring + chips in `Pages/Library`.
- Spoken Miles (2026-11-23): courses + products in `client_code/courses.py` (shared with the server). `#landing` = Pages/Choose,
  `#learn/<slug>` = Pages/Landing (one template, `<span data-v>` + VALUES). Gifts: `server_code/Gifts.py` + Pages/Gift, Redeem,
  ref `<user>-g<product>` in Shop.handle_event. Ads: `client_code/ads.py` -> `Customers.note_ad` (users.ad_source), Admin Ads/Customers.
  Offline: `theme/assets/sb-offline.js` + Pages/Downloads + `Listening.downloads_info/offline_pack`; Lesson plays saved lessons from a
  blob URL and opens offline from the saved meta (`_offline_lesson`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **error_log**: when:dt, source:str, kind:str, message:str, traceback:str, page:str, session:str, user→users
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **gifts**: code:str, product:str, buyer→users, buyer_email:str, to_name:str, message:str, amount:num, currency:str, session:str, payment_intent:str, source:str, created:dt, redeemed_by→users, redeemed_at:dt, refunded:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Customers, Gifts, Shop
- **listener_prefs**: user→users, goal_minutes:num, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Listening
- **listening**: user→users, course:str, day:date, seconds:num, is_demo:bool · used in Customers, DemoData, Listening
- **progress**: user→users, course:str, code:str, position:num, done:bool, completions:num, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Listening
- **purchases**: user→users, email:str, product:str, course:str, levels:obj, amount:num, currency:str, source:str, session:str, payment_intent:str, note:str, refunded:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Catalog, Customers, DemoData, Shop
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, remembered_logins:obj, ad_source:obj · used in Admin, Customers, DemoData, Shop
- **waitlist**: email:str, course:str, user→users, source:str, consent:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Shop

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/i18n_es.py`: The Spanish for the member pages. Edit here, then run:
- `tools/i18n_keys.py`: List every English text the member pages translate, and which ones have no Spanish yet.
- `tools/make_catalog.py`: Build server_code/lessons_data.py from the Spoken Miles course sources (Documents/CLAUDE/sayback).
- `tools/make_hero.py`: Make the landing hero's audio clips and their timing data.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/make_landing_lists.py`: Write Level 1's 30 lessons into both sales pages (between the lessons:start / lessons:end comments).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
